summary: Eight-metre kerb at a junction mouth, steep, with a house 15 m away.
reasons: Under one van length, at junction corner

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling 15 m north on the same side, more homes within 30 m; edges a busy arterial.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 8 m of kerb on the corner where Thorpe Street meets the main road; not a full van length and in the junction mouth.
drivers.convention: One car parked in the street beyond the corner; none on this kerb.

sun_shade: Partly shaded by garden trees on the north side.
